mapper.select: SELECT o.*, og.gid,good.`name` as good_name, og.count, og.standard, good.imgs FROM t_order o, order_goods og ,good WHERE o.id = og.order_id AND o.uid = #{uid} AND og.gid = good.gid ORDER BY o.create_time DESC

SELECT o.*, og.gid,good.`name` as name, og.standard,gs.price ,og.count, good.imgs FROM t_order o, order_goods og ,good,good_standard gs WHERE o.id = og.order_id AND o.order_no = #{orderNo} AND og.gid = good.gid AND gs.gid = og.gid AND gs.`value` = standard

SELECT o.*,og.gid,good.`name` as name, og.count, og.standard, good.imgs FROM t_order o, order_goods og ,good WHERE o.id = og.order_id AND o.seller = #{seller} AND og.gid = good.gid ORDER BY o.create_time DESC
